# Mini Cricsheet corpus

Generated by `scripts/tests/gen_cricsheet_mini.py` with fixed seed `20260910`.
The 20 JSON matches intentionally contain two competitions, a same-day pair
(`710008` and `710009`, distinct Cricsheet ids on 2025-01-09), one super-over
match (`710012`), and one Duckworth-Lewis result (`710005`). The generator
uses sorted keys, fixed indentation, and no timestamps so reruns are
byte-identical.
